image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a white baseball resting on a dark, textured fabric surface. The ball features traditional red stitching in a figure-eight pattern, black printed logos (Rawlings), and handwritten signatures/markings in black ink on the upper hemisphere. Lighting creates a soft highlight on the top left and a shadow underneath.

The cover is white/off-white with a grain consistent with leather.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The red stitching follows the characteristic double-helix/figure-eight path typical of baseball construction.

Specular highlights on the upper left indicate a smooth, semi-glossy surface typical of treated leather.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is taxonomically a baseball and not a similar spherical object (e.g., tennis ball, cricket ball) given the specific stitching patterns.
AI often fails to render individual raised threads correctly, causing them to melt into the leather or each other. This expert will verify the discrete nature of the stitches.
The image contains complex text (Rawlings logo) and handwriting. AI generators frequently produce gibberish or warped characters in these areas.
To ensure the ball sits naturally on the surface with correct occlusion and shadow softness, ruling out floating artifacts.

focus_areas: Legibility and geometry of printed/handwritten text
Surface texture consistency (leather grain vs. plastic smoothness)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'Rawlings' logo and the handwritten signatures. In AI-generated images, text often looks plausible at a glance but fails character-level inspection (warped letters, non-existent glyphs). Also, inspect the transition where the red thread enters the leather; AI often blurs this boundary rather than showing a clean puncture/exit point.
